messages:
anya: quick sync — i'm sketching a 'canary comparison' dashboard that shows runtime+infra signals side-by-side for A/B runs. want to align on which signals are mandatory vs optional.

sasha: +1. mandatory = p95 latency, p50 latency, 5xx rate, error budget burn, cpu/gpu util. optional = kv-cache hit rate, batch size distribution, memory spikes.

mike: also surface token_cost_per_request and tail-latency percentiles (p99). ops needs cost signal for canary gating.

anya: agree. thinking about grouping signals by ownership: runtime (latency, kv cache, batching), infra (util, node restarts), platform (routing failures, quota drops). who owns the mapping from a route -> signals?

julian: platform should own route->signal binding (console/rollout UX lives here). runtime/infra own measuring instruments and tags. julian: we can expose a small registry endpoint: `/v1/telemetry/signals` that lists canonical metrics and expected tags.

sasha: registry endpoint sounds good. need schema: name, unit, aggregation, recommended visualization, owners, alertable (bool), tags required e.g., `route`, `model_variant`, `deployment_zone`.

anya: prototype query for p95 latency:
```sql
SELECT route, percentile_latency(0.95) AS p95
FROM runtime.requests
WHERE experiment_id = 'exp-2026-04-01'
GROUP BY route
```
Use `experiment_id` and `treatment` tags to join.

mike: two practical asks: (1) dashboards should allow slice-by: region, instance_type, model_variant; (2) support rolling windows (5m/1h) and cohort diffs.

julian: UX note — show absolute and relative delta side-by-side + CI. non-statistical deltas confuse PMs. we should surface a simple significance heuristic (bootstrap CI or t-test).

metrics-bot: schema-check: `/v1/telemetry/signals` registered signal `kv_cache_hit_rate` missing unit field. PR: https://git.internal/r/telemetry/42

deploy-bot: infra deploy of telemetry-registry v1.3 started by julian — build #204. estimated 3m.

sasha: on alerting — for canaries we want transient tolerances. propose canary_alert_policy = { window: 15m, threshold_mult: 1.5, sustained: 3 } so small blips won't fail a canary. thoughts?

mike: fine but add cost cap check: if token_cost_per_request increases >20% and projected monthly spend delta > $X, trigger cost-review.

anya: next steps: julian to land registry endpoint + schema changes (owner/tags/visualization). runtime to publish example queries for each canonical signal. platform will prototype dashboard UI with slice controls + delta+CI. i'll schedule a 30m hangout tomorrow to review. :calendar:

sasha: tagging eng-sre for alert policy review. cc @mike for cost thresholds.

julian: will open PRs by EOD and add sample Grafana panels. linking design notes in ticket: https://go/rt/canary-dashboard-design

anya: thanks team — small follow-ups in the PRs.
